title: Seven Deadly Fitness Sins: Greed
summary: Part of NH's seven deadly fitness sins series, on greed in fitness and YouTube fitness. Captions are unusable; per the description, greed corrupts gradually until it owns you, but a total absence of greed breeds a passionless life, so the point is to control its energy.
claims: Greed is the great corruptor: it wins small battles until it controls you and the drive to possess more ends up owning you
A complete absence of greed leads to a demotivated, passionless life; like every sin it is neither fully good nor bad, what matters is staying in control of its energy
